description: This Java interface defines a client for interacting with Hono's Device Connection API, including methods to set and get the last known gateway for a device within a tenant.

classes.name: DeviceConnectionClient
classes.description: An interface for managing device gateway associations within the Hono platform, scoped to a specific tenant.

methods.name: setLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Sets the last gateway that acted on behalf of a specific device, returning a Future indicating success or failure.

methods.name: getLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the last gateway that acted on behalf of a device, returning a Future with the gateway ID or failing if not set.
